messages.subject: I spoke to her
messages.body:
She sent me her verification receipt. Her registration is 0001842. Mine is 0002917. We each had our own recovery address before this.

On screen our names look identical. Could you check what index-09 kept of the original forms we filled in? Support keeps closing her case as a duplicate. We need both records.

messages.subject: We have the records
messages.body:
I sent her the export. She laughed when I put the two names side by side. Then she asked me to send the numbered version too, so nobody could copy the wrong one into the case.

Support had been telling us one account needed to be deleted. We've sent them both verification records. We'd like to keep both accounts.

Thank you.

- Mira

messages.subject: I reopened both cases
messages.body:
Both original records came through. I reopened the appeals under 0001842 and 0002917. The queue team confirmed both rows are still there. The review queue shows one.

Could you check appeals-04 before I send either owner back through intake? I need to get both cases in front of a reviewer.
